fieldData.name: Arts & Sciences
fieldData.intro-1: Start your journey to university with the School of Arts & Sciences.
fieldData.short-description: We offer a flexible range of courses to help you build the foundation for transfer into your university program. Choose from 1 to 20 courses that align with your future goals, allowing you to create a personalized academic pathway for your transfer needs.

fieldData.name: Technology
fieldData.intro-1: Learn the skills you’ll need to change the world.
fieldData.short-description: The School of Technology equips you with the expertise to shape the future of software development, digital design, cybersecurity, interior decorating & design, and digital marketing. Prepare for a successful career with our diploma and post-diploma certificate programs.

fieldData.name: Health & Wellness
fieldData.short-description:
Through the School of Health and Wellness, it’s possible.

In just two years, you could become a Licensed Practical Nurse, Pharmacy Technician, Health Care Aide, and more. Together, we can make it happen.

fieldData.name: Community Studies
fieldData.short-description: Gain the skills to make a meaningful impact in social work, community development, the nonprofit sector, social enterprises, and social economy organizations, all while helping create stronger, more efficient communities.

fieldData.name: Entertainment Arts
fieldData.short-description: At the Bow Valley College Centre for Entertainment Arts (CEA), you'll learn from industry pros, build a killer portfolio, and gain the hands-on experience you need to launch your career in new media.
fieldData.intro-1: Step into the world of entertainment arts and master film production, visual effects, game design, or 3D animation.

fieldData.name: Business
fieldData.short-description:
At Chiu School of Business, we’ll help get you there.

Others talk business solutions. At Chiu School of Business, you’ll develop bold ideas, innovative thinking, and hands-on experience. You’ll be the solution.
fieldData.intro-1: Want to be work ready in one or two years?
